problem: The candidate makes a separate propulsion load case mandatory, but the requirement only requires the specified ice-milling load sequence case to be used for propulsion-line strength evaluation and excluded from stalling analyses. A conforming ship could represent that sequence through nltl:hasIceMillingSequenceCase without also having an independently linked nltl:hasPropulsionLoadCase.
required_change: Remove the mandatory nltl:hasPropulsionLoadCase property, or otherwise make it non-obligatory and semantically subordinate to the required ice-milling sequence case.
regression_guard: Preserve the mandatory ship-to-ice-milling-sequence-case path, its propulsion-line-strength-evaluation purpose, and its stalling-analysis exclusion.
